text: [issue by SwatPolizei] ### Describe the bug If you looking close to the ME Export Bus you can see trow it. ### How to reproduce the bug Place a ME Export Bus and look at the sides two pixels you can see are missing. ### Expected behavior Not seen trow. ### Additional details _No response_ ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log I [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] This is not very precise. Can you paste a screenshot of what you mean exactly? [comment by shartte (member)] I actually verified, and he's right. If you place an export bus, the status LED texture is missing and you can see through the chassis. (when unpowered) [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] The status led is not where you expect it. It's on the sides: The transparent spots are not filled in the model. It's probably because it reuses the "ae2:part/monitor_back" texture. [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] If you change that to "ae2:part/monitor_back_no_status" it looks like this: If that is what you want I can make a PR out of that. [comment by Mari023 (collaborator)] @Mithi83 with #8702 merged, can this be closed now? [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] Depends on what the policy for closing is. It is merged, but not yet released. I'm fine with both approaches. [comment by Mari023 (collaborator)] usually when merged, especially since merging can close the issue automatically when it is linked. otherwise it would likely be when it is released forgotten.
